Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 25: the slip of [[Empire's New Order (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Whenever an opponent's alien is just lost, they lose 1 Force. While all of your ability on table is provided by Imperials and Imperial starship pilots, Emperor, your admirals, generals, and moffs are deploy -1 and are forfeit +1. Aliens are deploy +1 and forfeit -1.”), word for word the text of [[Empire's New Order (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>c63bf528513446184251b17042bb3992227dc4906436348ed7fe1c38b9df3840</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[402, 215, 586, 304]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B4).
